headline: Nasdaq fell 1.4% below yesterday's low on Alphabet; Amazon and Intel slide after hours, BOJ decides tonight.
brief: The Nasdaq closed about 1.4% lower, below the prior day's low, as Alphabet sank on negative free cash flow and a hot September PCE print lifted December hike odds, though the 10-year yield fell about 7 bp. Amazon dropped after hours on an EPS miss despite faster AWS growth, and Intel also slid, keeping pressure on mega-cap tech into the reopen. The Bank of Japan decision during the Asia session and further after-hours tech weakness are the key risks.
